intents.reply: Hello! Welcome to Renty. We connect tenants with verified landlords — browse houses, bedsitters, single rooms, and apartments for rent across Kenya, and reserve your home with M-Pesa. How can I help you today?

We list a range of verified vacant homes — single rooms, bedsitters, 1–3 bedroom houses, and apartments. Every listing is posted by a real landlord and shows the rent, deposit, location, and photos. Browse them all on our Houses page.

context.single room: Single rooms are the most affordable option — ideal for students or singles. Prices vary by location.
context.bedsitter: Bedsitters come with a combined living/sleeping area and a private kitchen and bathroom. Popular in most Nairobi estates.
context.1 bedroom: 1-bedroom units offer a separate bedroom and living area — great for couples or small families.
context.apartments: Our apartments range from 1 to 3 bedrooms, mostly in town and in gated estates across Nairobi.

intents.reply: Every listing shows its monthly rent and deposit on the house page — the exact amount you'll pay to reserve it. Rent varies widely by location and house type, from budget bedsitters to premium apartments. Use the search filter or Near Me to find homes within your budget.

context.bedsitter: Bedsitters typically range from KES 5,000 to KES 15,000 per month depending on location.
context.single room: Single rooms are usually KES 3,000 to KES 8,000 per month.
context.1 bedroom: 1-bedroom units typically range from KES 10,000 to KES 25,000 per month.
context.deposit: Most landlords charge a deposit equal to one month's rent, shown on each listing before you pay.

intents.reply: You pay directly through the platform using M-Pesa. Click 'Rent Now' on a house, confirm on your phone, and the payment goes into a secure hold. Once you approve, it's released to the landlord. You don't pay the landlord directly.

context.how: Click Rent Now on the house you want. An M-Pesa prompt appears on your phone. Enter your PIN to pay.
context.hold: Your payment is held securely until you approve the release to the landlord — so you're protected if anything goes wrong.
context.receipt: Your payment and receipt appear in your dashboard under Payments.
context.failed: If the payment doesn't go through, you can try again — the house stays reserved for you during the attempt.

intents.reply: To rent a house: create a free account, browse or search for a home, click Rent Now on the one you want, and pay via M-Pesa. The house is reserved for you the moment you start the payment. Once payment is confirmed, it's yours.

context.account: You need a free Renty account to rent — sign up with your name, email, and M-Pesa phone number.
context.reserve: The moment you click Rent Now and start paying, the house is held for you — no one else can book it at the same time.
context.after: Once payment is confirmed, the house is marked occupied under your name. You'll see it in your dashboard.

intents.reply: Renty lists homes across Kenya, with the biggest concentration in Nairobi and surrounding areas. Use the Near Me button on the Houses page to find homes close to your current location.

context.nairobi: We list homes across Nairobi — Kilimani, Westlands, Karen, Umoja, Donholm, Kasarani, Ruaka, and more.
context.near me: Tap Near Me on the Houses page to see listings closest to you, sorted by distance.
context.outside: We also have listings in Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, and other counties.
context.search: Use the search bar to filter by house type or location.

intents.reply: Landlords can list houses for free. Create a landlord account, then in your dashboard use 'Add Unit' to upload the house type, rent, deposit, location, photos, and pin its exact position on the map. Your listing appears on the site immediately.

context.pin: Use the 'Pin location' button when adding a unit — stand at the house so the pin is accurate. Pinned listings appear in Near Me searches.
context.payment: You receive payment directly from Renty once the client approves the release — no chasing tenants for M-Pesa.
context.dashboard: Your landlord dashboard shows your units, payments received, and client details.

intents.reply: Creating a Renty account is free. Click 'Sign up', enter your full name, email, M-Pesa phone number, password, and choose whether you're a Client (looking to rent) or a Landlord (listing houses). You're ready in under a minute.

context.client: Client accounts are for people looking to rent a home.
context.landlord: Landlord accounts are for property owners who want to list and manage houses.
context.phone: Your M-Pesa phone number must be in the format 2547XXXXXXXX — that's the number that receives the payment prompt.
context.reset: Forgot your password? Use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.

intents.reply: Every Renty listing is posted by a verified landlord, and your payment is held securely until you approve its release. You only pay through the platform — never directly to a landlord — so you're protected end to end.

context.verified: Landlords sign up with their name, email, and M-Pesa phone number. The phone number is verified when payments are made.
context.hold: Your money is held until you approve. If the landlord doesn't deliver the house as described, you can withhold release.
context.no_cash: Never pay a landlord in cash outside Renty — you lose all protection if you do.

intents.reply: You can reach our support team at info@renty.co.ke or via call, SMS, or WhatsApp at +254727713219. For issues with a specific listing or payment, use your dashboard to raise a complaint, and we'll respond within 24 hours.

context.whatsapp: WhatsApp us at +254727713219 for the fastest response.
context.hours: Support hours are Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM.
context.complaint: Use the Complaints section in your dashboard to report a problem with a landlord, unit, or payment.

intents.reply: I'm Ann, the Renty assistant. I'm here to help you find a home, understand how renting works on the platform, or answer any question about payments and listings. What can I help you with?

context.robot: I'm Ann, a virtual assistant for Renty, here to help answer your questions about finding and renting a home.
context.human: I'm Ann, an automated assistant. For anything I can't answer, our team is reachable at info@renty.co.ke or +254727713219.
